For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

WITH customer_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date::DATE) AS min_date,
        MAX(txn_date::DATE) AS max_date
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(min_date, max_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY))::DATE AS date
    FROM customer_dates
),
daily_txns AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE AS date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS daily_net
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.date,
        COALESCE(t.daily_net, 0) AS daily_net,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.date) AS running_balance
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN daily_txns t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.date = t.date
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS avg_30d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date) AS day_num
    FROM daily_balances
),
first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(txn_date::DATE)) AS first_month
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date) AS month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.avg_30d < 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.avg_30d END) AS max_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_avg r
    JOIN first_month fm ON r.customer_id = fm.customer_id
    WHERE r.day_num >= 30
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date) > fm.first_month
    GROUP BY r.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date)
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(max_avg_30d) AS total_max_avg
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

args.sql:
WITH customer_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date::DATE) AS min_date,
        LAST_DAY((SELECT MAX(txn_date::DATE) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions)) AS max_date
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(min_date, max_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY))::DATE AS date
    FROM customer_dates
),
daily_txns AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE AS date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS daily_net
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.date,
        COALESCE(t.daily_net, 0) AS daily_net,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.date) AS running_balance
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN daily_txns t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.date = t.date
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS avg_30d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date) AS day_num
    FROM daily_balances
),
first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(txn_date::DATE)) AS first_month
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date) AS month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.avg_30d < 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.avg_30d END) AS max_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_avg r
    JOIN first_month fm ON r.customer_id = fm.customer_id
    WHERE r.day_num >= 30
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date) > fm.first_month
    GROUP BY r.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', r.date)
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month) AS month,
    ROUND(SUM(max_avg_30d), 2) AS total_max_avg
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
